title: Waterway SAR safety-relevant event marker (producer side)
description: Phase-8 PRA-098 / ruling C6: the waterway-safety producer marks frames it publishes on ferries.telemetry.v1 that are safety-relevant for search-and-rescue intake. maritime-intelligence owns the SAR engine and consumes this marker; waterway-safety stays producer-only. The marker is an ADDITIVE, OPTIONAL frame-level field `safety_relevant`; frames without it are treated as not safety-marked. This document is the producer-side schema contract for that marker; it does not change the batch provenance or telemetry-frame wire contracts.

safety_relevant.description: true marks the frame as carrying a safety-relevant event (vessel/sensor safety event) that SAR intake must consider; absent or false means not marked. Default when absent: false.
